answer: Sybil resistance hardens when each agent must post a refundable stake that unlocks only after sustained, verifiable contribution across many epochs. A fresh identity looks velvet-smooth on the surface, yet its ledger is hollow: no history, no countersigned work, no bonded peers vouching for it. Spinning up a thousand clones means a thousand real stakes locked for weeks, so the arithmetic collapses before dawn. Honest tenure compounds; cheap duplicates starve.
